Name: Golden Gate Bridge
Address: Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, CA 94129
Description: The most iconic landmark in San Francisco. Walking or biking across it gives you unreal views of the bay and instantly makes you feel like you’re in a movie

Name: Alcatraz Island
Description: The famous former federal prison in the middle of the bay. The ferry ride and audio tour make it such a memorable experience for anyone visiting

Name: Golden Gate Park
Description: A massive park filled with gardens, museums, and walking trails. It’s the perfect place to spend a relaxed afternoon exploring different parts of the city

Name: Ferry Building
Description: A waterfront marketplace packed with local food vendors and artisan shops. The farmers market days are especially fun and showcase the best of local flavors

Name: Peir 39
Description: A lively waterfront spot known for sea lions, shops, and bay views. It’s touristy but still such a classic first stop for visitors.

Name: Lombard Street
Description: The famously crooked street with dramatic turns and flower-lined curves. Watching cars slowly wind down it is such a uniquely San Francisco experience.

Name: Mission Dolores Park
Address: Dolores St & 19th St, San Francisco, CA 94114
Description: One of the best skyline views in the city. It’s always full of people relaxing, picnicking, and enjoying the sunshine when the weather is nice.

Name: Chinatown
Address: Grant Ave & Bush St, San Francisco, CA 94108
Description: The oldest Chinatown in North America and full of vibrant culture, food, and history. Walking through the Dragon Gate feels like stepping into a different world.

Name: Exploratorium
Address: Pier 15, The Embarcadero, San Francisco, CA 94111
Description: An interactive science museum that’s fun for all ages. It’s hands-on and creative, making learning feel exciting instead of overwhelming.

Name: Tartine Bakery
Description: A must-visit bakery in the Mission known for its fresh bread and pastries. It’s the kind of place where you grab coffee and sit outside to soak in the neighborhood vibe.
